author: DeimosX
quote: I was eagerly awaiting news about the long‑awaited release, but the absence of a version for personal computers genuinely saddens me. It seems strange to me that such a major game ignores the huge audience of players on the platform. Moreover, I was disappointed to learn that many game mechanics and freedoms are severely restricted. I was hoping for complete realism and the absence of such limitations in the gameplay. It’s hard to imagine how such restrictions will affect the overall impression of this huge metropolis. I hope the developers will listen to the community’s opinion and reconsider their priorities in the future. And I’ll reconsider my assessment.
